task.description: Type C/D design for ISS-0686. (2) Verify PartitionRetention.runArchivalAging() queries plat_partition_catalog and would pick up the events_legacy entry. (3) Specify exact column values for the plat_partition_catalog insert. Write design to src/design/ISS-0686-events-legacy-archival-integration.md.
